title: Xtrium Materials Graph Schema
description: Schema for a single material record transformed from NASA TPSX Open Materials Database per SOP-DS-001 v1.3

material_id.description: Assigned by load_to_neo4j.py at import time. Always null in exported files.

material_name.description: Full material name exactly as it appears in NASA TPSX. REQUIRED.

canonical_name.description: Lowercase, spaces replaced with hyphens, special characters removed. e.g. 'aluminum-6061-t6'

cas_number.description: CAS registry number. Always null — NASA TPSX does not provide CAS numbers.

uns_number.description: UNS designation. Always null — NASA TPSX does not provide UNS numbers.

icsd_id.description: ICSD database ID. Always null for this dataset.

inchikey.description: InChIKey identifier. Always null for this dataset.

external_id_type.description: Type of external identifier. Always null for this dataset.

chemical_formula.description: Extracted from Composition field ONLY when the entire cell is a formula string (e.g. Ti-6Al-4V). Null if prose or mixed content.

material_type.description: Material type mapped from NASA Category field per SOP §5.2 mapping table.

material_subtype.description: Interpreted from Composition/Description if clearly stated. Otherwise null.

grade.description: Unambiguous grade/variant token extracted from Material_Name (e.g. 'T6', 'Grade 5', '450G'). Null if no discrete grade token.

trade_names.description: Trade names extracted from Name/Description fields. Empty array [] if none found.

is_variant.description: True only if material is clearly a variant of a base material. Default false.

base_material_canonical_name.description: Canonical name of base material. Null unless is_variant is true.

supplier_context.description: Supplier and source context per SOP §5.3

supplier_canonical_name.description: Fixed mapping from Database_Source per SOP §5.3 mapping table.

supplier_product_id.description: Not in NASA data. Always null.

datasheet_url.description: MaterialDetail URL from URL column. e.g. https://tpsx.arc.nasa.gov/Material?id=N

properties.description: Array of material property objects. One object per property instance per SOP §6.

name.description: Human-readable property name with spaces and Title Case. e.g. 'Tensile Strength Isotropic'

canonical_name.description: snake_case property name. No hyphens. e.g. 'tensile_strength_isotropic'

value.description: Exact CSV string value. No scientific notation — converted to plain decimal. e.g. '288', '0.0000000608', '0.0899', '40-60'

numeric_value.description: Parsed float of value string. Null if value is non-numeric (range, text).

unit.description: Unit of measurement from _Units column. Null if not provided.

condition.description: Test condition. Built from STP mapping + instance label. e.g. 'STP', 'Non-STP', 'assumed STP', 'Non-STP, Instance 1'. Null if no condition information.

property_category.description: Category assigned per SOP §6.4 classification table.

raw.description: All CSV sub-columns for this property. No null values — absent keys are omitted entirely per SOP §10.

Uncertainty.description: Plain decimal string. No scientific notation.

STP.description: Raw STP value as read from CSV. e.g. 'True', 'nonstp', 'assumed/assumed'

instance.description: Present only when multiple instances of this property exist in the row.

stp_review_note.description: Present only when STP value is not in SOP §6.2 mapping table.

source.description: Property-level source. Uses SHORT form 'NASA TPSX' or named standard code.

source_name.description: Short form: 'NASA TPSX', or named standard code if _Source is ASTM/ISO/NASA-TM. Never the long form 'NASA TPSX Materials Database'.

standards_referenced.description: Standard codes parsed from Property_References. e.g. ['ASTM D638', 'ISO 527-1']. Empty array [] if none.

compliance_references.description: Always [] — not provided in NASA TPSX data.

applications_mentioned.description: Always [] — not provided in NASA TPSX data.

processing_notes.description: Combined free-text from Composition, Description, Notes, TRL, Manufacturer, Original Category, Pictures (non-URL). Segments joined with double newline. Null if all source fields empty.

hazard_flags.description: Always [] — not provided in NASA TPSX data.

availability_notes.description: Always null — not provided in NASA TPSX data.

images.description: Image entries parsed from Pictures column URLs. Empty [] if no URLs.

image_data.description: Always null — binary data not in CSV.

sources.description: Citation sources. First entry always NASA TPSX Materials Database (long form). Additional entries for NASA-TM codes.

source_name.description: Top-level ALWAYS uses long form: 'NASA TPSX Materials Database'.

raw.description: Source metadata. Keys omitted if CSV cell empty or suppressed artefact.

Property_References.description: Full raw text per SOP §8.2 fidelity rule.
